prompt:
Equipment redesign of this exact blue/gold Chinese ghost-deity heavy guard.
User explicitly says NO SWORD; design a large shield appropriate to him.

REMOVE the entire sword, scabbard, red-wrapped sword handle, sword guard and its red hanging tassel. No sword remains anywhere, no replacement polearm or second weapon.

ADD ONE COHERENT OVERSIZED CHINESE SPIRIT-WARD TOWER SHIELD carried on the arm at SCREEN RIGHT where the sword was:
- Heavy GATE-TOWER silhouette, NON-ROUND, physically LEFT-RIGHT SYMMETRICAL around its vertical centerline. Short raised center crown like a simple Chinese gate lintel, matching chamfered shoulder corners, long mostly straight sides and broad bottom with matching clipped corners. No medieval kite point or circular rim.
- Height roughly from his shoulder/upper chest down to upper ankle, width substantial but offset outward so his face, main shoulder mask and both boots remain visible. Large thick edge with a readable side/back plane and believable weight.
- Palette: deep navy/cobalt main shield body, one thick restrained antique-gold structural border, a small pale-cyan ghost accent. Match his existing armor. Only 3–5 dominant shield graphic regions.
- Front design ONE LARGE SIMPLE BILATERALLY SYMMETRIC SPIRIT-WARD motif: two mirrored stepped/cloud-brow bronze shapes near upper center and two small pale-cyan eye-slit insets, meeting one broad central vertical armor ridge. This should subtly suggest a Chinese guardian mask/gate seal in abstract graphic form. Lower two-thirds mostly quiet blue planes. NO detailed face with rows of teeth, horns everywhere, turtle/serpent relief, tiny runes, studs, gemstones scattered about, multiple concentric rims or engraving.
- Keep the actual geometric shield design symmetric; show only mild perspective so symmetric structure remains obvious.
- The carrying forearm has a believable grip/strap on the BACK of the shield. Adjust the old sword-holding arm naturally to brace the shield; hand may be partly concealed, with correct elbow/shoulder connection. Do not paste a shield over an existing sword hand. Exactly two arms; other armored fist stays relaxed on screen-left.

PRESERVE the character's mature fierce HUMAN face, dark hair/beard with ivory streak, compact broad powerful body, blue/gold/red Chinese heavy armor, enormous guardian-mask shoulder at screen-left, pale mane collar with cyan ghost-flame curls, small cloud ribbons, grounded stance and all key design identity. The shield should complement the main shoulder mask, not compete with it through extra detailed decoration. Preserve the face direction and body proportions. Do not make the shield hide the whole character.
Same project GEM ICON rendering: thick controlled dark contour, few big coherent matte color/value planes, simple readable volumes, no noisy tiny facets or high-gloss 3D metal. Whole figure and whole new shield safely in square plain warm ivory canvas, no text, frames, scene, corpse or ground shadow. Output one finished shield guard only.
purpose: Remove sword and design a large symmetric non-round blue/gold spirit-ward shield that complements the ghost-general armor.
visual_review: Sword removed; large non-round gate-shaped shield added with blue/gold palette, mirrored guardian-brow motif and cyan eye accents, coordinated with shoulder mask.

design_history.prompt:
Use case: character style-transfer with a restrained supernatural design fusion.
IMPORTANT INPUT MAPPING: IMAGE1 is the USER'S SECOND ATTACHED IMAGE — the heavily armored blue/gold male general — and is the PRIMARY CHARACTER TO REDRAW. IMAGE2 is the user's first attached image, the turquoise spirit, and supplies only SOME ghost-deity motifs. IMAGE3 is the actual project defense GEM ICON painting reference. IMAGE4 is an existing project character for compact body proportions and clear standing presentation. Draw ONE general only.

PRIMARY IDENTITY AND COSTUME:
Keep the primary armored general's mature Chinese male identity: powerful broad shoulders and thick build, angular stern face, swept loose black forelocks, dark hair tied back, pointed dark beard with small ivory streak, intense simple amber eyes. He stays a HUMAN man wearing armor, not a blue-skinned monster.
Recognizable huge asymmetrical guardian-mask shoulder armor, tall backward-curving architectural horn/scroll-shaped armor extensions, broad pale collar, dark blue heavy armor and cloth, muted antique-gold edging, small restrained crimson plates/cords. Main colors remain COBALT/DEEP NAVY and antique gold with IVORY, tiny crimson accents.
Translate the excessive source detail into meaningful large shapes: one huge shoulder mask, one broad plated chest, one wide waist sash/buckle, two or three large layered skirt/apron plates, substantial bracers, thick boots. Remove all rows of tiny rivets, tiny scale armor, many straps, gems everywhere and repeated mini masks. Shoulder mask is the main large supernatural ornament; waist closure becomes a simple quiet geometric bronze shape rather than another detailed face.
Keep the source's heavy ceremonial blade at his side: one broad dark-blue/gold SHEATHED SWORD, red-wrapped handle gripped by one hand at hip/waist, blade/scabbard extending diagonally down beside leg, coherent single grip/guard/sheath construction. Other hand rests as a relaxed armored fist by his side. No second weapon or floating disconnected mask weapon.

GHOST-DEITY ELEMENTS FROM IMAGE2 — CONTROLLED AND INTEGRATED:
- Transform the source's white fur collar into a mix of thick ivory guardian-mane shapes and a SMALL PALE-CYAN GHOST-FLAME crest, only 3–4 broad upward curling lobes. No hundreds of hairs, no big smoke cloud.
- Main shoulder guardian face becomes a stylized Chinese NUO/guardian-spirit mask: deep blue/crimson plane, two simple pale cyan eye slits, one broad ivory mouth/tooth shape, short gold horn/crest framing. No realistically detailed teeth, gore, scary flesh or skull clutter.
- Repeat ONE broad cloud-qi curl in one armor/hem region. At most two short thick pale blue-gray ceremonial cloth ribbons trailing behind shoulder/waist, kept subordinate to the heavy armor.
- Keep supernatural cyan as small accents around collar and mask only, not neon all over the suit or a full body aura. Face stays visible and human.

CRITICAL PROJECT PROPORTIONS AND POSE:
Compact approximately FOUR actual HEAD HEIGHTS crown-to-sole EXCLUDING tall shoulder extensions, like image4. Actual head occupies about one quarter anatomical body height; enlarge it relative to the tall small-headed source, shorten torso/thighs/shins organically, keep strong broad masculine mass and substantial hands/boots. Not a tall six/seven-head poster warrior and not obese.
Full face/chest/pelvis/knees/boots front THREE-QUARTER SCREEN LEFT, calm protective planted standing stance. Both boots on ground, one supporting leg and one relaxed slightly forward. No foot on a creature, no lunge or floating pose.
REMOVE the source's severed head, blood, corpse, black rectangle background, floor splatter and ground shadow. Only the intact living armored character is part of the redraw.

PROJECT GEM ICON PAINTING:
Image3 supplies big decisive matte front/top/side planes, strong dark contours and restrained broad hand-painted strokes. Each material has 2–3 large coherent value groups, meaningful broad curved/angular silhouette. Blue armor feels thick and substantial, metals softly matte, cloth organic. No photoreal crystals, little triangle mosaic, noisy brush grain, tiny scratches, realistic skin/eyes, glitter or reflective 3D render. Facial skin gets one quiet broad warm shadow, not facets.
One complete full-body character safely inside square warm ivory plain canvas, including highest shoulder ornaments, weapon and both boots, with 7–8 percent margin. No labels, frame, title, extra characters, ground objects or scene. The recognizable image1 armored general should now look at home in the project's compact gem-icon cast with a tasteful hint of Chinese ghost-deity power.
design_history.purpose: Redraw user's second armored-general reference in project gem-icon style, with restrained ghost-flame and guardian-mask motifs from the first reference.

design_history.prompt:
Proportion and simplification correction of IMAGE1's ghost-deity armored general to match this game's character scale in IMAGE2. Output the general only, not the woman.

The current real head is TOO SMALL and the torso/legs too LONG. Redraw decisively to approximately FOUR actual head heights skull-crown to foot-soles, EXCLUDING huge shoulder ornaments/flames. Increase the REAL male skull/face size by 35–40 percent relative to body. Shorten below-neck torso and both thigh/shin segments evenly by about 20 percent. Short strong neck, powerful broad shoulders and sturdy compact male anatomy. Do not shrink the head to make room for the large shoulder ornament. Head/face should have the readable scale relative to body seen in image2, while remaining the same mature stern male with black hair, beard and ivory beard streak. No horizontal/vertical squash.
Keep his HUMAN face clearly front THREE-QUARTER SCREEN LEFT, nose/pupils left, with a natural neck; do not make the head look back over a right-facing torso. Coherent chest/pelvis/boots orientation and grounded stance.

Keep the distinctive design: blue/gold Chinese heavy armor, ONE oversized guardian-mask shoulder with architectural horns, pale ivory collar plus a FEW cyan ghost-flame curls, deep navy skirt/apron plates, small crimson chest accent, heavy bracers/boots, same sheathed broad sword at side, two short cloud-ribbons. No return to the previous generic blue shield guard.
Rebalance shoulder ornament to suit compact body: still huge and dominant, but reduce height of its tall backward scroll-shaped horns so face stays a major focal point and whole design fits the square. Keep shoulder mask as a broad simple red/deep-blue face with only two cyan eye shapes and one grouped tooth band. No tiny multiple teeth, micro carvings or new ornaments.
Simplify the entire armor to 2–3 large coherent matte value groups per piece, broader quiet blue surfaces and a few strong gold edges. Merge noisy brush fragments and tiny facets on gold/blue armor. Ivory collar in 3–4 thick grouped mane/flame shapes rather than a row of many spikes; cyan flames are a few clean curls, no sparkles/particles. Face/skin one broad warm shadow, no faceting. Retain Chinese ghost-deity theme and powerful guardian presence.
Image2 is for compactness and clean game-icon clarity ONLY, no copied female identity, color, costume or weapon. No realistic rendering, dirty grain, noisy polygon mosaic, dense metal ornament or glossy 3D effect.
ONE full-body male general on plain warm ivory square background, entire highest armor ornament, sword and both boots safely in frame. No corpses, blood, ground props, floor shadow, lettering, border, panel or additional characters.
design_history.purpose: Refine ghost-general rendering into compact project icon proportions and simpler large armor planes.
